(curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6', 'CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0')) ) SELECT 'GROUP' AS record_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= jlg.prop_value::DECIMAL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= shg.prop_value::DECIMAL) THEN lcb.group_id END) AS tat_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > jlg.prop_value::DECIMAL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > shg.prop_value::DECIMAL) THEN lcb.group_id END) AS tat_not_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 24 THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > 24 THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip_greater_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip, SUM(CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' OR lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') THEN lafdst.requested_amount END) AS login_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_not_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_not_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS reject_count FROM mfi_reporting.los_credit_base lcb JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd ON gmd.group_id = lcb.group_id LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.loan_app_financial_details_staging_table lafdst ON lafdst.loan_app_id = gmd.loan_app_id LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.los_credit_base credit ON credit.group_id = lcb.group_id AND credit.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND credit.is_next_stage_created IS TRUE LEFT JOIN jlg_tat_hour jlg ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN shg_tat_hour shg ON 1 = 1 JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = lcb.assignee_contributor and rhc.user_id is not null;

queries.sqlPreview: WITH jlg_tat_hour as (select prop_value from mfi_masterdata."configuration" where prop_key = 'task.jlg.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), shg_tat_hour as (select prop_value from mfi_masterdata."configuration" where prop_key = 'task.shg.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), ind_tat_hour as (select prop_value from mfi_masterdata."configuration" where prop_key = 'task.ind.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), role_hierarchy_cte as( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint, LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6', 'CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0')) ) SELECT 'INDV' AS record_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= ind.prop_value::DECIMAL THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS tat_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > ind.prop_value::DECIMAL THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS tat_not_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 24 THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > 24 THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip_greater_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip, SUM(CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' OR lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') THEN lafdst.requested_amount END) AS login_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS approved_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS approved_not_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_not_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED' THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS reject_count FROM mfi_reporting.los_credit_base lcb LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.loan_app_financial_details_staging_table lafdst ON lafdst.loan_app_id = lcb.loan_app_id LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.los_credit_base credit ON credit.loan_app_id = lcb.loan_app_id AND credit.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND credit.is_next_stage_created IS TRUE LEFT JOIN ind_tat_hour ind ON 1 = 1 JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = lcb.assignee_contributor and rhc.user_id is not null;

mfi_actor."user" u_max on u_max.id = gtd_max.updated_by::integer left join mfi_actor.employee e_max on e_max.actor_id = u_max.actor_id group by gcut_1.group_id, gcut_1.min_task_id, gcut_1.max_task_id uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint , LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0'), (curh.cfe_user_id, 'CFE') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6','CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5','CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4','CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3','CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2','CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1','CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0','CFE')) ), rejections_data AS ( select count(la.loan_app_id) as reject_count, la.reject_reason AS reject_reason FROM mfi_reporting.loan_app_stage_staging_table la JOIN mfi_reporting.office_details od ON la.office_id = od.id JOIN mfi_actor.country_state_district csd ON od.state = csd."name" AND csd.level_id = 2 JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer ON uer.user_id::text = la.rejected_by JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = uer.user_id WHERE la.reject_stage IN ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Conduct BET/SHG Rating', 'Conduct PD') AND la.reject_reason != '' AND la.reject_reason IS NOT null and 1=1 GROUP BY la.reject_reason ), total_rejections AS ( SELECT sum(reject_count) AS total_rejection_count FROM rejections_data ) , ranked AS ( SELECT rejections_data.reject_reason, ROUND( (SUM(rejections_data.reject_count) * 100.0) / (SELECT total_rejection_count FROM total_rejections), 2 ) AS rejection_percentage FROM rejections_data GROUP BY rejections_data.reject_reason ) SELECT reject_reason, CONCAT(rejection_percentage, '%') AS rejection_percentage FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(rejection_percentage), 2), '%') FROM ranked;

queries.sqlPreview: WITH role_hierarchy_cte AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint , LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0'), (curh.cfe_user_id, 'CFE') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6','CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5','CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4','CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3','CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2','CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1','CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0','CFE')) ), rejection_data AS ( SELECT gd.reject_reason AS reject_reason, COUNT(gd.group_id) AS rejection_count FROM mfi_reporting.loan_app_stage_staging_table gd JOIN mfi_reporting.office_details od ON gd.office_id = od.id JOIN mfi_actor.country_state_district csd ON od.state = csd."name" AND csd.level_id = 2 JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer ON uer.user_id::text = gd.rejected_by JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = uer.user_id WHERE gd.reject_stage IN ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Conduct BET', 'Conduct PD','Conduct BET/SHG Rating') AND gd.reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND gd.reject_reason <> '' and gd.product_code IN ('JLGDL', 'SHGDL') and 1=1 GROUP BY gd.reject_reason ), total_rejections AS ( SELECT SUM(rejection_count) AS total_rejection_count FROM rejection_data ), ranked AS ( SELECT rejection_data.reject_reason, SUM(rejection_data.rejection_count) AS rejection_count, ROUND( (SUM(rejection_data.rejection_count) * 100.0) / (SELECT total_rejection_count FROM total_rejections), 2 ) AS rejection_percentage FROM rejection_data GROUP BY rejection_data.reject_reason ) SELECT reject_reason, CONCAT(rejection_percentage, '%') AS rejection_percentage FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(rejection_percentage), 2), '%') FROM ranked;

group_id, md.members_count AS group_member_count, gd.group_name AS group_name, CONCAT_WS(' ', b.first_name, b.middle_name, b.last_name) AS customer_name, o.name AS branch, o.external_branch_code AS fw_code, rmh.rm_employee_id AS rm_emp_id, rmh.rm_formatted_id AS rm_code, rmh.rm_name AS rm_name, rmh.ch_formatted_id AS circle_head_code, rmh.ch_name AS circle_head_name, rmh.crh_formatted_id AS ch_code, rmh.crh_name AS ch_name, rmh.rbh_formatted_id AS rbh_code, rmh.rbh_name AS rbh_name, la.requested_amount AS loan_applied_amt, la.approved_amount AS loan_approved_amt, he4.name AS state, p.code AS product, latdd.updated_on AS dde, gd.created_on AS login_date, gd.created_on AS application_sign_date, e.formatted_id AS sales_executive_code, gtd.updated_on AS date_of_the_bet, la.disbursed_amount AS disb_amt, latdq.updated_on AS qde_complete_date, dlp.completed_on AS disbdate, (SELECT task_status FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctdm.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS final_und_status, (SELECT updated_on FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctdm.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE) AS final_und_status_date, CASE WHEN la.status = 'Cancelled' THEN la.updated_on ELSE NULL END AS cancel_on, CASE WHEN la.status = 'Cancelled' THEN la.reject_reason ELSE NULL END AS cancel_reason, CASE WHEN la.status = 'Cancelled' THEN la.updated_by ELSE NULL END AS cancel_by, la.reject_reason AS reject_reason1, la.loan_term AS approved_tenor, (SELECT first_name FROM mfi_actor.user WHERE id = (SELECT updated_by FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctd.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE AND task_status = 'COMPLETED')::INTEGER) AS first_approver_name, (SELECT updated_by FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctdm.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE AND task_status = 'COMPLETED') AS final_und_user, (SELECT first_name FROM mfi_actor.user WHERE id = (SELECT updated_by FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctdm.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE AND task_status = 'COMPLETED')::INTEGER) AS final_credit_buyer_name, lidd.installment_amount AS emi, (CASE WHEN la.loan_type = 'ETB' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS EXISTING_CUSTOMER_N, (CASE WHEN la.loan_type = 'ETB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS EXISTING_CUSTOMER_Y, rmh.zh_formatted_id AS zh_code, rmh.zh_name AS zh_name, (SELECT first_name FROM mfi_actor.user WHERE id = (SELECT updated_by FROM mfi_los.group__task_details WHERE task_id = ctdm.task_id AND is_deleted = FALSE AND task_status = 'COMPLETED')::INTEGER) AS cm_name, CASE WHEN la.loan_type = 'ETB' THEN 'RENEWAL' ELSE 'FRESH' END AS fresh_renewal, 'Y' AS imaging_flag, pc.promo_code_name AS sales_promotion_code, la.formatted_id AS app_id_c, vtc.name AS village, db.lan_id AS finnone_lan_no, CASE WHEN gmd.is_signatory_one = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS key_flag, b.borrower_religion_code AS religion, la.psl_category AS psl_sourcing, la.rate_of_interest AS irr, CASE WHEN gd.lead_generator = 'DSA' then gd.dsa_code WHEN gd.lead_generator = 'CSC VLE' then gd.lead_number WHEN la.lead_generator = 'DSA' then la.sub_dsa_code WHEN la.lead_generator = 'CSC VLE' then la.lead_number ELSE 'Direct' END AS channel FROM mfi_los.loan_app la JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd ON la.id = gmd.loan_app_id AND gmd.is_deleted = FALSE JOIN mfi_los.group_details gd ON gmd.group_id = gd.id AND gd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.group_id = gd.id LEFT JOIN mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latdq ON la.id = latdq.loan_app_id AND latdq.is_deleted = FALSE AND latdq.task_sub_type = 'QUICK_DATA_ENTRY' AND latdq.task_status = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latdd ON la.id = latdd.loan_app_id AND latdd.is_deleted = FALSE AND latdd.task_sub_type = = la.id and ed2.is_deleted is false LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.office o ON (o.id = la.office_id) LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.office__address__mapping oam ON (oam.office_id = o.id) LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.address oadd ON la.id AND b.borrower_type = 'BORROWER' AND b.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.account a ON a.account_number = la.loan_account_number LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_installment_details AS
